tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background. The espresso ground of every dark asset; warm paper in light.

tokens.name: page-a
tokens.usage: Lighter stop of the page's radial glow (top-left of heroes, covers and social images).

tokens.name: page-b
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the page glow.

tokens.name: page-c
tokens.usage: Darkest stop of the page glow, at the far corner.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Quiet alternate surface: blog body sections, footers.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, terminal windows, the tilted back card.

tokens.name: panel-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells: code blocks, input fields.

tokens.name: panel-sunk-glass
tokens.usage: Sticky bars over content (translucent panel-sunk).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Chip and tag fill: the new() code chip, feature chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text on page, paper and panel. Also the B tile fill (dark) — the tile always uses ink with on-ink lettering.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Running text and subtitles on page and panel (10.6:1 dark, 6.6:1 light).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, footers, captions. Dark: 6.6:1 on page. Light: 4.8:1 on panel but only 4.0:1 on page — on the light page use it at 18px+ or use text-body.

tokens.name: muted-soft
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only; never for content.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The brand orange, exactly as on bytes.coffee. Use it for fills with no small text on them (wipes, cover blocks, video cards' big type) and for the italic accent word. As TEXT it is display-only (24px+): 4.4:1 dark / 3.7:1 light on page. Anything carrying small text uses orange-fill.

tokens.name: orange-fill
tokens.usage: Orange for any surface that carries text smaller than 24px: primary buttons, the card fronts (their kickers are small), tags. With on-accent it reads 4.8:1 in dark and 4.6:1 in light. Pure brand fills with no small text on them (wipes, cover blocks, the italic accent word) keep orange.

tokens.name: orange-dark
tokens.usage: Orange for small text: links, kickers, the $ prompt, the code chip's letters (8.9:1 dark / 6.9:1 light on page). Called peach in the dark collateral. Also the 2px focus ring on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Deep orange: the answer underline on cards, pressed buttons, the Daily Regrets calendar strip.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on orange-fill and accent-deep (4.8:1 / 4.6:1 on orange-fill, 6.3:1 / 8.8:1 on accent-deep). On plain orange in the dark theme it only reaches 4.1:1, so put it there only at 24px+ or 19px+ bold.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Lettering on an ink fill (the B tile).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules: header/footer dividers, the rule above a social image's footer.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default component border (outlined buttons, inputs).

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Low-emphasis separators inside panels.

tokens.name: border-card
tokens.usage: Edges of chips, cards and the tilted back card.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover borders on outlined buttons and inputs. Not the focus ring: at 2.0:1 on the light page it's too faint; focus uses orange-dark.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: Colour of the hard offset shadow on the hero card.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Colour of small offset shadows (buttons, code chip).

tokens.name: shadow-diffuse
tokens.usage: Soft ambient shadow colour.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals.

tokens.name: signal-good
tokens.usage: Success, 'posted', a winning score. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: signal-bad
tokens.usage: Errors, 'faltered', a failed check. Always paired with a word.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces at ExtraBold with tight tracking. One accent word per headline goes italic in orange.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headlines and social images. On the web it scales with clamp(3.5rem, 10vw, 5rem).

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers, slide titles, card consequences.

styles.name: display-accent
styles.usage: The single italic accent word, in orange. Also card answers.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and blog post titles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Manrope for everything people read at length.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A new home for things I make, thoughts I write, and ideas worth staying up for.
styles.usage: The line under a hero headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rooms are deliberately temporary. When the host ends one, it's deleted outright.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: DM Mono for the machine's voice: commands, metadata, kickers.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Eyebrow above a headline. ALWAYS uppercase, in orange-dark.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands and code; the $ prompt in orange-dark.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: A little code. A lot of coffee.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between a kicker and its headline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row; nav item gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default gap between stacked elements in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between a headline and its lead.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero column gap; the gutter between text and the card stack.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: The inline code chip (scales with its text).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Terminal windows and code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Web cards (the tilted hero card).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The B tile at 56px (about 21% of its side); scale proportionally.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards in social images and videos (1200px-wide canvases).

shadow.note: The web uses hard offset shadows with no blur, like a card resting on a table. Media (social images, video) uses one soft drop shadow under the front card.

tokens.name: elev-chip
tokens.usage: The code chip.

tokens.name: elev-button
tokens.usage: Buttons at rest; drop to none when pressed.

tokens.name: elev-card
tokens.usage: The hero card on the web.

tokens.name: elev-media
tokens.usage: The front card in social images and video frames, over the dark ground only.
